message:
## Vulnerability Digest

**Scan window:** 16 November 2026 07:40 UTC to 17 November 2026 07:40 UTC (13:10 IST on each date).
**Scope:** DLL_software_component.txt only, with duplicate component names consolidated and listed versions retained, plus the mandatory MongoDB ecosystem sweep.

No new vulnerabilities were verified as relevant to the listed DLL components or the MongoDB ecosystem during the scan window. Search coverage is limited and this is not a guarantee that no relevant issues exist.

### MongoDB ecosystem

The dedicated sweep searched for MongoDB Server and its editions, mongod/mongos, Atlas and services, management tools, Compass, mongosh, database tools, Kubernetes operators, drivers, connectors, BI Connector, Charts, Realm/App Services, integrations and MongoDB-owned advisories, using vendor, CVE, GitHub and security research sources. The [MongoDB Server security update for CVE-2026-118383](https://www.mongodb.com/community/forums/t/important-mongodb-security-update-available-action-required-november-10-2026/344843) was published on 10 November and is outside this window. A new [AdminNeo advisory](https://www.rapid7.com/db/vulnerabilities/cve-2026-130378/) concerns AdminNeo's own MongoDB integration, not a verified flaw in MongoDB; AdminNeo is not in the assigned component list.

**Closing:** No immediate review is recommended based on newly verified findings from this scan. Older vulnerabilities and unverified or undated reports were not assessed as new.
